title: Coherent Sequence Wave Computer
description: Classical, SYNTHETIC Python reference implementation of phase-based associative memory. Random bit patterns are encoded as BPSK wave-states, stored in one complex Hopfield coupling matrix and recalled by phase dynamics. Recall fidelity is read out with the phase-coherence formula C_seq = || from Mun Seok Lee's Coherent Sequence theory, applied to the relative phase. Includes an OES-32 block score (reported as a convergence flag, since it also fires on never-stored cues, noise and an empty memory), seeded capacity and confabulation sweeps, and SHA-256 evidence passports. Not quantum hardware; not a validation of the Coherent Sequence theory; no physical claim.
